name: How do I choose the right commercial cleanup company?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right commercial cleanup company?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a commercial cleanup company, look for experience with commercial properties, proper certifications (e.g., IICRC for water or fire damage), 24/7 availability, and positive client references. Ensure they are licensed and insured. A reputable company will provide clear communication, a detailed action plan, and work directly with your insurance provider.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a company with commercial experience, certifications, 24/7 availability, and good references, ensuring they are licensed and insured.
